items.title: Bill Allred interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: Louie Bellson was from my hometown. I got to do some things with Louie, played with Louie

ctx.x: Yeah. There’s a chemistry to maintain with a number of people like that.

Yeah and there are guys that are just bastards. There was a drummer that played too loud. And you say something to him and people are very, very, very particular about how they play. And you’ve got to be really careful. Like don’t say, too many notes, or not enough notes, or the guy isn’t reading the charts. There was one, a drummer that, I mean he could read but he had to get the arrangements. We were doing some stuff by Louie Bellson and that. And that’s pretty heavy drum stuff. And I said, “Look, just spend a…
Right. What’s the first question that you ask when someone calls with an inquiry about your band?
